# Pulse task #2885: Add nested group tracks with Live 12-style headers and submix routing

Operation: db731edf2e563f630623c87239d050bc
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User request19October2026: group tracks underneath another group track, in a similar style/look to Ableton Live12. Duplicate searches group tracks/track group/group bus found no matching ticket. Official reference https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/mixing/ GroupTracks: folding/expanding children, nested groups and submix routing; use as workflow/visual reference within Hex theme/shared widgets, not copied assets.

Full intended outcome: group/ungroup selected ordinary tracks, nested hierarchy and reorder/reparent by header drag with clear insertion feedback; compact colored parent/group header with disclosure arrow and visibly indented children, stable geometry and selection when collapsed/expanded in Arrange and Console. Group has its own gain/pan/mute/solo/meter and audio-effect chain using the same shared track controls/device panel. Group represents a submix, not a visual-only folder or fake regular instrument track; children routed to group sum once through group effects/fader and onward to parent/Main. Preserve explicit custom output routing when grouping, following existing canonical routing law; avoid implicit double-to-Main. Reject self/descendant/cyclic routing and grouping Main/Returns; define actual finite nesting/count limits within existing budgets. Group audio effects only, no directly playable MIDI/audio clips on group unless separately designed/authorized. Collapse is UI state, never mutes or changes routing. Respect selection/mute/solo/send semantics and do not silently erase child state.

Canonical model/commands/save-reopen/UndoRedo must retain stable hierarchy, order, devices and routing; deletion policy clearly distinguishes ungroup/retain children from explicit delete group with children. Do not reuse clip-G behavior as a shortcut accidentally; context actions Group/Ungroup first and inspect existing shortcut conflicts before any shortcut choice. Existing routing2836/Main-chain2882/shared-chain2756 are related boundaries, not permission to import unfinished whole branches. Active alpha means no legacy migrations/backward compatibility required; preserve actual user media/projects.

Implementation must inspect current model/prepared render/track-layout dispatch first, return a bounded architectural design for major graph/ownership choices before writing cross-subsystem code. Keep this real multi-subsystem feature explicit, not count a cosmetic header-only milestone as completion. Phases may use focused linked PRs after reviewed design. Acceptance: nested group create/reparent/collapse/delete/ungroup in both views; actual PCM summed once through group effects, routing cycle and invalid-target refusal, mute/solo controls, save/reopen and atomic UndoRedo, limits/resource budgets, rendered headers/dropfeedback; exact appropriate local CI and finite optimized native test. No new cloud role; queue existing General executor after current urgent regressions. No native interaction/install/hostedCI authorized by tracking.
